name: Facet
text: Adopt a **system-wide dark theme by default** with a **persistent, non-modal light/dark toggle** in the top-right corner. This matches the dark themes in Manus’ Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard, ensuring visual consistency and reducing eye strain in low-light conditions. The trade-off is that users accustomed to light themes may initially resist, but the toggle lets them switch instantly, and the default aligns with the majority of modern data tools.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A system-wide dark theme still forces glare-sensitive users into the same one-size-fits-all—outdoor sunlight or migraines don’t care about your toggle. Instead, let users pick a *theme per view* (e.g., dark for graphs, light for tables) and settle the argument with a 2-week A/B test measuring glare complaints and task completion time.
